mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and may reduce ritonavir levels, creating bidirectional interaction complexity.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor cenobamate levels closely; dose adjustment of cenobamate may be necessary, and efficacy of ritonavir-based antiretroviral regimens should be verified.
